about: The SISO base set, by layer: which library a part comes from, in order. Shaan, 12 Oct 2026 (.agents/source/2026-10-12-library-walk.md): 'Tier 1: we download everything shadcn UI, but if there's Arc, we take Arc over shadcn'; gap-fill libraries add only what we don't have, or replace ours when their code is more technical. Agents pick deterministically from this, then tokens make them one family.
rule: take the first library in the layer that has the part
a gap-fill library adds a part only if no earlier library has it, or its code is clearly more complete (states, keyboard, a11y)
paid tiers (Arc Pro, reui Pro, Kobra) are reference only: rebuild, never copy
motion is its own layer, wired into parts afterwards

app-parts.note: reui free parts for data grids, dashboard parts and app shells; watermelon for clean standard variations; react-aria and intentui are not for looks but for behaviour and edge cases (keyboard, a11y, i18n) when ours lacks them

charts.note: take all: many chart types is the point

landing-blocks.note: efferd's variation sets are the model for client and industry sites; shadcn-ui-blocks' categories are the model taxonomy

blog_note: SISO Labs' own blog is the design; 7ovr's parts go into it, not the other way round
